claims.text: US Patent 2,417,347, 'VIBRATION DAMPER', issued 11 March 1947, prints its inventor line as 'Thomas T. Brown, Laguna Beach, Calif., assignor by mesne assignments to Lockheed Aircraft Corporation'.

edges.label: US 2,417,347 assigned by mesne assignments to Lockheed Aircraft Corporation
edges.note: The patent's own inventor line reads 'Thomas T. Brown, Laguna Beach, Calif., assignor by mesne assignments to Lockheed Aircraft Corporation'. This is the one item in Brown's self-authored biography that a second document corroborates.
